note: What the checks need to know about this game. A new game fills these in; the checks themselves stay as they are.

autopilot.note: The frames the autopilot cart (src/main.c GAME_AUTOPILOT) takes to finish its run: the programs check and ./programs.sh play it to the end.

newcomer.note: Level 1's goal and the debug fields that hold the on-screen cues (src/main.c publishes them).

move.note: per player: x right, y up on screen, the way the HUD arrow points

press.note: per player: 1 while the {jump} prompt shows

grounding.note: Frames of the autopilot cart (src/main.c GAME_AUTOPILOT) when nothing should be in the air: crates settled, no player mid-jump.

flash.note: The effects with a flash meter (src/main.c fl_*), and a run of the autopilot cart that shows each: lanterns found, a fall (the player dropped into the chasm by a debug request) and its respawn dip, the beacon lit.
